title: release-cindy-plugin

goal.text: Release the Cindy plugin from its independent marketplace repository.

requirements.summary: Release only the independent Cindy adapter repository, verify its marketplace source, and publish the matching vcindy tag without an archive.
acceptanceCriteria: Both Cindy manifests use the resolved CLI three-segment base plus a newly incremented fourth segment; the independent repository does not own a separate three-segment version line.
The claw-kit-cindy marketplace entry points at plugin.
The tagged adapter-repository ghost manifest is valid and matches vcindy-<version>.
No .cindy archive, GitHub Release, or npm package is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Cindy release baseline
tasks.detail: Open chanyuenpang/claw-kit-cindy-adapter. Resolve the CLI base from the authorized batch candidate or published @veewo/claw, then read RELEASING.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags for that base, Cindy manifests, marketplace entry, and every worktree change. Reject main-repository changes or an unresolved CLI base.

tasks.title: Prepare and verify the Cindy source
tasks.detail: Set only the adapter-repository package.json and plugin/ghost.json to <cli-base>.<next-fourth>; validate the shared CLI three-segment prefix, manifest constraints, and claw-kit-cindy marketplace source, then run focused checks and review the complete diff.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source release gate
tasks.detail: Commit intended adapter content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run the focused adapter tests, then create and push vcindy-<version>.

tasks.title: Publish the Cindy marketplace source
tasks.detail: Verify the tagged adapter marketplace resolves claw-kit-cindy to plugin and the target ghost.json version. Do not build a .cindy archive or create a GitHub Release; Cindy packages the source locally when the user installs or updates it.

tasks.title: Verify the Cindy release and optional install
tasks.detail: Verify tag, origin/main equality, marketplace source path, manifest version, and repository cleanliness. Only when separately requested, refresh the custom market, accept Cindy confirmation, check logs, restart, and verify enabled/running target version.

references.why: Owns manifest, marketplace, tag, publication, migration, and installation rules.

rules: Never publish npm packages or modify another adapter.
Never build or upload a .cindy archive for a marketplace release.
Never publish changed Cindy plugin bytes without increasing the manifest version.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
